supersedes.note: V1 and V2 contracts, generators and results stay unchanged; V3 is a separate generator built on V2

declaration.purpose: Close the APPROVE-path gaps V2 measured, exactly as the operator decided before V3: A guidance structured parsing IMPLEMENT, B priced-in IMPLEMENT, C catalyst minimal code-owned state IMPLEMENT, D invalidation minimal code-owned state IMPLEMENT, E large re-rating NEGATIVE DEFERRED.

numbers_reused.statutory filing deadlines: SEC Form 10-K/10-Q General Instruction A via V1 R3.5

declaration.revision_rule: a rule change after the replay is a new contract version (V4); only a class-D implementation bug fix is allowed, recorded with before/after hashes

unchanged_from_v2: R3.5 next periodic report and horizon

guidance_parser_v2.sources: D2.1 package chunks, PIT-eligible, per source in chunk order; no new source class
guidance_parser_v2.lines: NBSP folded; a table row is a line with '|' split into non-empty cells; a bullet is a line (or a first table cell) that is one glyph of {•, ●, ·, ▪, ■, ◦, ‣, –, —, -, *, o} followed by text, or a glyph-only line followed by its text line
guidance_parser_v2.heading_like: a non-table, non-bullet line with a letter, not ending in '.', ';' or ',', and with no digit outside period expressions

scope.opens: a heading-like line or a table header row (no digits outside periods) that the frozen GUIDANCE_TERMS locate
scope.period: the single period that heading states; two or more, or a quarter named without a year next to a non-quarter period ('Third Quarter and Full Year 2026 Outlook'), -> none (ambiguous); a later heading-like line inside the scope that states one period replaces it (subheading)
scope.ends: the next guidance heading (new scope), a prose line that the term list does not locate and that yields no transcription, or the end of the source; no inheritance from outside the enclosing scope

structures.S1_prose: V1 templates T1-T3 on located sentences (and on every sentence inside a scope); plus T5: a period phrase right after a range ('for|in [the] <period>') binds that range; coordinated ranges and list continuations ', [and] [<label> (of|in the range of|to be|at)] <range>' in the same sentence; the scope period when the sentence states none
structures.S2_bullet: inside a scope: prose templates first, else '<label> [:|—|–|-|of|in the range of|to be|at|is|are] <range> [for <period>]' followed by end, ',', ';', '(' or '.'
structures.S3_table_row: inside a scope: first cell = label, the other cells' ranges; one range -> the label's period, else the header's single period, else the scope period; n ranges -> the header row's n period columns in order; a header ending in 'Low | High' pairs two singles into a range; anything else -> GUIDANCE_PERIOD_UNKNOWN (AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN)
structures.S4_label_value: inside a scope: a heading-like label line immediately followed by a line that is only a range

guidance_parser_v2.values: structural values (S2-S4) need a currency, percent or basis-point marker; V1 range grammar, scale, units and raw/normalised values unchanged; no estimate, interpolation, annualisation or midpoint is created
guidance_parser_v2.metric_key: V1 key plus lexical normalisation only: footnote markers removed, 'Adj.' -> 'adjusted', 'revenues' -> 'revenue', '&' -> 'and', punctuation removed; different economic metrics are never merged
guidance_parser_v2.period_normalisation: YEAR<Y> (bare year) -> FY<Y> only when the issuer's SEC submissions fiscalYearEnd is 1231; otherwise kept apart
guidance_parser_v2.pairing_and_direction: V1 assess unchanged: same (metric key, period, unit family), latest publication = current, in-sentence or latest earlier publication = previous, complete bounds, classify_range_movement via MOVEMENT_TO_STATE; one-sided, conflict, incomplete -> UNKNOWN
guidance_parser_v2.overall_state: the single definite per-metric state; two or more different definite states -> MIXED (the D4 schema's MarketExpectationEvidenceV1 rule); none -> UNKNOWN

priced_in_v1.basis: D0 §M lists 'valuation vs the company's own historical range' as market expectation evidence; D5_D2R_V1 is that range for each issuer (TP1 = Base percentile value, TP2 = Bull percentile value), read on the two boundaries D6 already uses

inputs_audited_not_used.event / benchmark-adjusted returns, pre-: numbers only in the repository: no frozen state or threshold turns them into 'priced'

table: D5 status != VALUED, a target missing, or D5 confidence not LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH -> UNKNOWN
priced_in_v1.confidence: the D5 confidence the reading rests on
priced_in_v1.c7: evidence id CODE:D5:<ticker>:<window>:<method> and the stated limitation (no PIT consensus)

catalyst_v1.taxonomy: H forward contract material_events (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, EARNINGS_RELEASE, GUIDANCE, MATERIAL_CORPORATE_EVENT) and research_queue rank 1 (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K 2.02 = earnings)
catalyst_v1.upcoming_event: only the next periodic report of R3.5 is a code-derivable future event
catalyst_v1.state: MATERIAL when that report is a 10-Q or 10-K inside the horizon; STANDARD for any other derived form; UNKNOWN when underivable or beyond the horizon (V1 rules then apply unchanged)
catalyst_v1.timing: BOUNDED_STATUTORY_DEADLINE (date = the statutory deadline, an upper bound) when derived inside the horizon, else UNKNOWN

d3_fields.materiality_candidate: MATERIAL -> HIGH, STANDARD -> LOW, UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
d3_fields.timing_confidence: BOUNDED_STATUTORY_DEADLINE -> MEDIUM (date bounded, exact day not known), UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN

conditions: INV:FUNDAMENTAL:<core metric> for each core metric (revenue, operating_income, eps_diluted, free_cash_flow, operating_margin) whose R3.2 state is supporting: trigger = that metric's code-owned state becomes adverse
INV:GUIDANCE:<key> for each code-owned guidance assessment RAISED: trigger = the same key LOWERED by classify_range_movement
invalidation_v1.status: ACTIVE for conditions on the current thesis; TRIGGERED for an ACTIVE condition of the issuer's previous V3 thesis (latest earlier evaluation artifact) whose trigger now holds, with reason code and evidence id; state = TRIGGERED if any, else ACTIVE if any condition, else UNKNOWN
invalidation_v1.d3_fields: invalidation_candidates = ACTIVE conditions (code-templated descriptions, the condition's SEC source); risks += BUSINESS for each adverse core state, each ACTIVE condition ('thesis-supporting state may reverse') and each TRIGGERED condition
invalidation_v1.unknown_fields: 'catalyst_materiality' dropped when the catalyst state is not UNKNOWN; 'invalidation_candidates' dropped when at least one condition is written

d4_gap_v3.basis: D0 §L POSITIVE: evidenced improvement and/or real future-business evidence, with at least low-to-medium confidence that the market has not fully priced it; C1 non-price evidence; C3/C4 ceilings; C5; C6; C7
table_in_order: U1 D3 has no final output -> UNKNOWN
U2 no code-owned guidance assessment in {RAISED, LOWERED, MAINTAINED, MIXED} (C1/C6) -> UNKNOWN
U3 overall guidance MIXED or any GUIDANCE_CONFLICT -> UNKNOWN
P overall guidance RAISED AND >= 1 core metric in IMPROVING_STATES AND priced-in in {LIKELY_NOT_PRICED, PARTIALLY_PRICED} -> POSITIVE
N otherwise -> NEUTRAL (the evidence is sufficient and the positive conjunction does not hold)
d4_gap_v3.confidence: UNKNOWN for UNKNOWN (C5); else min(C4/C3 ceiling, priced-in confidence)
d4_gap_v3.negative: not produced: LARGE_RERATING_NEGATIVE DEFERRED (operator decision E); 'not yet reflected in price/guidance' has no frozen reading; LOWERED guidance is reflected in guidance -> NEUTRAL
d4_gap_v3.wide_positive: not produced: C2 needs a future-business item above STORY (R3.4 none) and the D0 valuation conjunct stays deferred

executor: D5_D2R_V1 row computed once before D4 by the unchanged value_issuer call and reused by D6 (checked by sha); previous thesis read from the latest earlier evaluation artifact of the same ticker

fixtures_declared_before_running.A_positive: guidance RAISED (structured), improving core state, D5 upside_to_TP1 > 0, D5 MEDIUM -> POSITIVE / MEDIUM
fixtures_declared_before_running.D_lowered: guidance LOWERED -> NEUTRAL (no frozen NEGATIVE path)
fixtures_declared_before_running.D6: fixture A + D5 MEDIUM upside + catalyst MATERIAL/BOUNDED + ACTIVE invalidation -> D6 APPROVE -> paper PENDING_ENTRY, D6 and paper unchanged

expected_effect_declared_before_running.APPROVE: reachable from the deterministic pipeline when: business evidence, an anchored code-owned change, a derivable next report inside the horizon, >= 1 supporting core state, a structured guidance RAISED pair, price below the D5 Base value with D5 confidence MEDIUM or higher
expected_effect_declared_before_running.E_class_on_approve_path: none by construction; large re-rating NEGATIVE DEFERRED (not on the APPROVE path)
expected_effect_declared_before_running.pass_requires_real_direction_count: > 0 on the stored corpus and real runs; not tuned after freeze
